cases.input: Synthetic HR case-ticket process: 120 cases in 20 business days; observed handling 0.5 hr/case and staffed capacity 4 agents × 5 productive hr/day × 20 days = 400 hr; recorded rework 24 cases. Propose measuring wait time and rework causes before a pilot; no workflow change.
